# Two splits: one on a liability account, the other on an income account.
# `Income:Vendor Rebates USD` +100.00 against `Liabilities:Credit Card USD`
# −100.00.
#
# A bill's line may be booked to income — a vendor rebate is — so a bill's
# posting can book an income account, and this transaction carries a split on
# the same one.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Income:Vendor Rebates USD
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Credit Card USD
	type: Credit Card
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-02-24 * "Rebate settled on the card"
	guid: "445566778899aabbccddeeff00112233"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Income:Vendor Rebates USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "5566778899aabbccddeeff0011223344"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Credit Card USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "66778899aabbccddeeff001122334455"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
